== June 2017 partial, original fields and document chronology ==
The actual source cover instructs using the bottom cutout with the original physical card. Lower printed fields are literal; uncovered title/destiny/lore/type and set icons are inherited from the independently verified [[:File:ANH-D-captainkhurgee-decipher-archive.gif]]. Default landspeed 1 is in the 1998 Glossary page 34 and current AR page 77. The game-text words already occur in the 1998 Glossary page 32 and current AR page 106; this is not a claim of a new 2017gameplay change. PC image sequence is partial2017→full 2018→full2022, marksE/E/D-E1. Existing current <code>2_83</code> and its Card redirect remain on [[Captain Khurgee (Errata)]], supported by that actual Decipher document and engine constructor; these image pages invent no executable IDs.
